justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/validator/language_level_validations/Java16Validator.java` (45 lines): it has one constructor and no other methods, and that constructor only adjusts four inherited validators for Java 16 features (`remove(noPatternMatchingInstanceOf)`, `remove(noRecordDeclaration)`, `remove(innerClasses)`, `add(recordAsTypeIdentifierNotAllowed)`, `add(recordDeclarationValidator)`). `Java15Validator.java` and `Java14Validator.java` show the same incremental inheritance pattern, so this class is a thin version-specific adapter, not an insufficiently modularized multi-responsibility class.
